limitations: County-wide: all of Los Angeles County (89 jurisdictions), no ZIP filter, roll 2026, built from the whole-roll cache (2429 pages). The cache was downloaded with every field; the build keeps only the fields it reads.

Permits: City of Los Angeles only (LADBS, data.lacity.org): 6 building-permit datasets, cached with the filter "work description contains ROOF", and the contractor view 8guu-8f5m. Permit sources not yet covered (88 jurisdictions without a classified permit source): Unincorporated Los Angeles County (EPIC-LA), Agoura Hills, Alhambra, Arcadia, Artesia, Avalon, Azusa, Baldwin Park, Bell, Bell Gardens, Bellflower, Beverly Hills, Bradbury, Burbank, Calabasas, Carson, Cerritos, Claremont, Commerce, Compton, Covina, Cudahy, Culver City, Diamond Bar, Downey, Duarte, El Monte, El Segundo, Gardena, Glendale, Glendora, Hawaiian Gardens, Hawthorne, Hermosa Beach, Hidden Hills, Huntington Park, Industry, Inglewood, Irwindale, La Canada Flintridge, La Habra Heights, La Mirada, La Puente, La Verne, Lakewood, Lancaster, Lawndale, Lomita, Long Beach, Lynwood, Malibu, Manhattan Beach, Maywood, Monrovia, Montebello, Monterey Park, Norwalk, Palmdale, Palos Verdes Estates, Paramount, Pasadena, Pico Rivera, Pomona, Rancho Palos Verdes, Redondo Beach, Rolling Hills, Rolling Hills Estates, Rosemead, San Dimas, San Fernando, San Gabriel, San Marino, Santa Clarita, Santa Fe Springs, Santa Monica, Sierra Madre, Signal Hill, South El Monte, South Gate, South Pasadena, Temple City, Torrance, Vernon, Walnut, West Covina, West Hollywood, Westlake Village, Whittier.

Permit-to-parcel join: the APN equal to the AIN, else a full address match (house number, normalized street name and ZIP; direction and fraction agree where both carry one; map book and page only narrow). No coordinate matching: the nearest parcel centre can be a neighbour's parcel. 8082 of 296909 permits (2.72%) stay unjoined, counted by cause in permits.unjoined_by_cause; their parcels keep the year-built proxy.

Condo buildings: a permit that matches the units of one building attaches to every unit (building_level) and is counted once (8941 permits, 67892 units). The roof decision belongs to the owners' association.

Roofing work is roof_r or roof_only with whole-word matching; partial repairs are included. 574 permits are roofing work only through "COATING TO AN EXISTING ROOF": they stay in the permit table but never set a roof year.

Effective roof year: the year of the status date of the latest roofing permit with status Permit Finaled linked to the parcel (building-level links count for every unit); otherwise the year built, a PROXY (roof_age_basis says which). The status date is taken as the final date: a sample check against final inspections supports it, it is not a confirmation. Permits dated after the reference date or in a year before the year built are ignored (permits.roof_permits_ignored).

Status classes: open-issued (the only class counted as open for long-open), open-application (details only), closed, and unclear (Quality Review Completed, CofO in Progress: neither open nor closed). Unknown statuses are "unmapped" and counted. open_since is the issue date (open-issued) or the submitted date (open-application); open_days counts to the reference date 2026-11-12, never the build date.
Permit work descriptions are not served: the free text can hold people's names. The build reads them only to set the roofing flags.

Contractor rows: business names and license numbers as LADBS publishes them; the license class is normalized to the CSLB form, and unknown values are unmapped and counted; owner-builder and N/A rows carry no license number. Contractor rows exist only for permits issued 2013-01-02 to 2023-05-19.

60 permits join parcels outside the City of Los Angeles (by method in permits.joined_outside_permit_jurisdiction): border, annexation or APN-typo cases, kept and counted. Parcels outside the City of Los Angeles have no permit data (permit_data_available false).
The LADBS inspections dataset (9w5z-rg2h) is not used: it records final inspections for only part of the roofing permits, and the permit status is the more complete signal.

Permit data terms: the building-permit datasets state no license (https://data.lacity.org/terms-of-use, May 2014); the contractor view is CC BY 4.0. Attribution: LADBS (City of Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety); the datasets' attribution field reads "TSB".
PUBLICATION BLOCKER: republication rights under the LA County eGIS Terms of Use ('for informational purposes') are unverified. Nothing may be published until confirmed and approved.
Year built and effective year built are a roof-age PROXY, not roof installation dates. Source value 0 is treated as unknown (null).

last_recording_date is the assessor's latest recorded document date, not necessarily a sale or ownership transfer. owner_unchanged_10y_proxy = last_recording_date <= reference date - 10 years; it can understate (non-transfer recordings) and is null when no date.
out_of_area_owner is null for every row: the open roll has no owner mailing address. Owner mailing data exists only in a secured county service that is not used.
No owner names, mailing addresses or contact fields exist in the source; no person entities and no private owner file were produced.
Coordinates are assessor parcel center points, not rooftop or address-point geocodes; rows without them are left null (not geocoded).

Lexicon names are taken from the bundled kit catalog (use-neutral-lexicon model-c) without the live Elephant lexicon/MCP; source_* columns, roof_age_basis, coordinate_basis, *_proxy, last_recording_date, tax_rate_area_city, roll_year and assessor_id_formatted are not lexicon fields; property_usage_type/property_type enums are not mapped (raw use code kept).

Permit tables: permit_number, application_received_date, permit_issue_date, unnormalized_address, postal_code, parcel_identifier, license_identifier, license_expiration_date, city_name, state_code and is_owner_builder follow the bundled lexicon; raw LADBS values keep source_* names (they are not lexicon enum values); status_date, the status class, open_since/open_days, the roofing flags, join columns, license class columns, contractors_business_name, permit_data_available, effective_roof_year, roof_year_permit_number and the rule versions are not lexicon fields.
Radius queries see every parcel with assessor coordinates; the 10595 parcels without them never appear in radius results.
